integrity_notes: The algebraic proof establishes the complete singular spectrum and optimization. Standalone symbolic and numerical checks are supplementary. Independent external validation and complete historical precedence assessment remain open.
scientific_limitations: Equal-step deterministic extragradient with two alternating unit 1-by-2 bilinear payoff rows only.
A one-period Euclidean operator-norm optimum, not an asymptotic spectral-radius optimum or a runtime result.
No guarantees for arbitrary nonunit rows, larger neutral dimensions, stochastic or nonlinear problems.
title: The universal half-power step for two-phase rank-one extragradient
